NOTE: the section-specific qualitative rubric wording differs from the generic option_text band descriptors currently in this table -- see GitHub issue #1616 for detail; option_text itself was not changed here.
item_text: Results: appropriate presentation and analysis of data/fieldwork/information gathered - worth 20% of the overall mark. Graded on a band scale from A1 (exceptional clarity of expression with comprehensive and profound interpretive understanding, academic publication quality) through B/C/D bands (very good to superficial analysis/presentation with decreasing interpretive depth) to F1-F3 (weak/limited analysis with no valid findings presented or interpreted) and N (no results section/no genuine attempt).
option_text: B1: Meets all the intended learning outcomes and exceeds the threshold expectations for this level in several of them
